The Financial Options Review Checklist

What to gather, write down and ask while you're paying for Mom's care.

Download PDF

Mom's care is paid from her accounts every month, and everyone seems to have a rule to offer about her savings. This list isn't about the care bill you're already paying. It's for the other decisions: before your family spends down, transfers money, changes ownership, sells something or buys a financial product, these are the things to have in hand. Check what you've done. Anything unchecked is something still to gather or ask, not a verdict on anything your family has done.

Gather

Write down

Ask

What this checklist doesn't do

It helps you gather, write down and ask. It doesn't say what has to be spent, how any asset is treated, or whether any gift, sale or purchase is a good idea. Rules vary by state, and those answers come from your Medicaid planner and the licensed professionals who know Mom's state and her situation. Nothing here is legal, financial or tax advice.

Where this comes from

Items marked 1 follow the record-keeping habits in the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau's guide for people who manage money for a family member. The rest come from the Medicaid Planning Roadmap's own working list for this step.
